shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical/horizontal stone surface
quadruped with four legs in profile
repeated row of similar heads/figures along the top
justification: Both are relief surfaces divided into registers with profile animals, and both have a row of repeated small forms along an upper band, but that is generic. A shows no human figures at all — instead abstracted animal heads, a crouching quadruped, snake-like and bird forms in isolated, non-narrative placement — while B is a crowded narrative procession of human archers, a bearded king, harnessed horses and a spoked chariot wheel, with naturalistic proportions and dense internal detail utterly unlike A's flat, schematic silhouettes.
